_about: The Dream (Robin, 2026-11-03): after the Hollow King a ferry from Crownhaven goes to the Dreaming Isle; at its Dreamgate a dungeon is laid for that run only, at a depth you choose, deeper and harder each time. Fall: lose the run's gold, keep the gear and the Dreamdust. Dreamdust only drops here and buys from the merchant at the camp. Robin, 2026-11-03: about 45 spots, not 18. Every number here mine, first settings for the bots to try.
_aboutPlace: Where a run is laid: free sea at the top right, off every land. Every run is laid in the same box; only its dreamer sees it.
_aboutLayout: The road: `hubs` named spots left to right, `step` apart, the gate first and the boss last, `minis` and `springs` at those places; between each two, `roadSpots` plain spots; `loops` side roads that leave the road and rejoin it two hubs on, `spurs` dead ends with a hoard at the end, `chests` chests on the roads.
_aboutTints: A run's colour, laid over its ground, its creatures and the gear it drops (Mitch, AD may change these).
hubNames: A Door That Was Not There
_aboutElements: The boss's element: the boss trick it fights with in place of its own, and the word in the run's name.

trick.text: Dream fire burns round it: it hits harder the longer the fight lasts.
Every third round it freezes into a shell of dream ice: hit it twice as hard to get through.
Every third round its thorns weep poison onto you.
Every third round dream lightning strikes you through any guard.

_aboutFoes: A creature in the Dream is measured from you, as in the Arena (mostly what you wear, some your class's bare numbers at your level): it lasts about `rounds` of your Attacks and its plain blow takes `hit` of your HP. Each depth past the first adds `perDepth` to both. `xp` is a share of your level's bar; `gold` goes into the run's purse; `dust` straight to you.
_aboutSpots: What a plain spot in the Dream holds: a fight mostly, now and then a moment of the land, or a drift of Dreamdust.
_aboutLoot: Gear found in the Dream is of rank `rankFrom` at the first depth and one rank more every `depthsPerRank` depths, past Everbright as Rank 11 and on; it carries the run's colour.
_aboutMerchant: The camp's merchant: for gold, the best flasks and dice cards (items with "dream" in their stock); for Dreamdust, the Dream's own trinkets and a piece of your choice at the rank of your best depth, legendary.
